scope.description: Entry-retirement semantics of actual MsgStorageAppendResp messages in AsyncStorageWrites mode across a monotonic Raft term transition.
assumptions: Non-Byzantine caller returns emitted local response messages unchanged.
Append-worker requests are processed reliably and in order; response release follows completion of the request and all earlier storage work.
excluded: Snapshot completion carried by a response.
Crash recovery, disk hardware failures and arbitrary message fabrication.
General eventual reclamation, application correctness or consensus safety proof.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Adds a package-local Go test only; no target implementation, dependencies or protocol logic are replaced.
The caller-owned network and storage workers are deterministic test scheduling adapters. MemoryStorage substitutes for an unspecified durable backend under a no-crash scope.
Reads unexported state for setup checks and endpoint observation; no direct writes to term, vote, progress, log, commit or unstable state.
Normal application entries have no external state machine; configuration entries are applied through ApplyConfChange before storage-apply responses. This does not create an application-level result.

plan_uncertainties: The measured requirement is conservative term filtering, not whether this particular completion could cause data loss.
The schedule contains no competing overwrite; it does not reproduce the broader overwrite scenario described in source comments.
The permitted current-term control is emitted as raw diagnostic observation and is not a separately monitored liveness obligation.
A local build was used for construction only; formal evidence must come from trusted execution of these fixed artifacts.
grounding_unresolved: A passing source review would not establish execution reachability or the real worker prefix.
No competing in-flight suffix overwrite, crash reconstruction, or application/client endpoint is tested.
Offset is a library-internal observation, not an application reply or durable-disk observation.
